plugins.name: vitrinka
plugins.description: Screenshot journeys, annotation boards, and the AI expression layer — 21 skills in four modules: Core (publish = captured work [session·journey·walkthrough·board], artifact = authored [standalone·pages·diagram·docs board], brainstorming, listen, resolve, answers, annotations), PM (tasks, release, pickup, spot, handoff), QA (sessions, pair, usertest, review) and Me (todo, todo-list, todo-done, todo-milestone, remind). Modules are presets over Claude Code's skillOverrides via `vitrinka skills`; the vitrinka MCP server is registered separately by `vitrinka install` (secret-free stdio forwarder).
